Reference / web/app

web/app#

Binds a route table to a listener: HTTP/1.1 in cleartext, or HTTPS with HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 offered by ALPN (#80).

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

await WebApplication(routes).listen(address: "127.0.0.1", port: 8000);
await WebApplication(routes).listen(address: "0.0.0.0", port: 8443, tls: identity);

Description#

Binds a route table to a listener: HTTP/1.1 in cleartext, or HTTPS with HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1 offered by ALPN (#80).

listen() serves until SIGTERM or SIGINT: then the server stops accepting, gives the requests in flight 10 seconds to finish, closes, and listen() returns; a second signal ends the process at once. The address is an IP literal; no name resolution happens here. server() binds and returns the std HttpServer without serving, for callers that own the lifetime themselves: port 0 picks a free port, local_endpoint() reports it, and server.drain(limit:) drains it.
